typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	var_copy_recipients as string (),
	var_duplicate_pt_row_id as integer (),
	var_pms_input_file_name as string (),
	var_recipients as string ()
}

source(output(
		request_source as string,
		patient_row_id as string,
		date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select request_source, patient_row_id, cast( cast(getdate() as date) as varchar(20) ) as date from [ecms].[pms_patient] group by request_source, patient_row_id having count(*) > 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCecmspmspatient
SRCecmspmspatient derive({Copy of patient_row_id} = toString(patient_row_id),
		{Copy of request_source} = toString(request_source),
		{Copy of date} = toString(date)) ~> DataConversion
